scope: Mechanical Git executable-mode normalization in post-commit source binding; numerical gate and DPPO scientific source unchanged.
rule: Committed file bytes and Git executable flag (owner-execute bit) must match the gate snapshot. Current scientific source bytes and all three execute permission bits must still match the gate snapshot exactly.
new_regression: Gate/current mode0770 versus committed Git mode0755 is accepted without modifying either source tree; committed nonexecutable mode0644 is rejected.
